comparison.objective: Dose loose tea into an infuser and seat it in a cup; candidate separates media from washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Scoop-based particle dosing and loaded-container insertion versus screen pouring, orientation-dependent passage, and bridge clearing.
comparison.success_condition: 24–33 tea pieces retained in a seated infuser with no spill versus ≥98% media recovered while every washer stays in the screen.
comparison.reason: Dry-particle handling overlaps, but dosing into a container does not test selective screening of a mixed population.
